selection: First deterministic sampled interval in each of all96 exposed validation clip/gap/context cohorts. No appearance-based selection.
control_selection: The lowest positional error among original projected linear/Hermite/shape cohort reports. This is an explicitly post-evaluation diagnostic control, not an inference algorithm.
source_data: Frozen v19 training manifest, validation partition only; all six confirmation clips remain unopened.
display: Joint-center skeletons in a fixed rest-calibrated world-up frame, with common camera, scale and timeline across panels. No mesh/twist/contact-surface or Cascadeur assessment is implied.
feedback: Optional locally downloadable human review, bound to model and dataset hashes. Automation never fabricates human ratings.
